art_direction.style: Original friendly 2D educational Shorts avatar; clean flat vector/cartoon illustration, rounded shapes, expressive eyes, simple soft shading, bold readable silhouette, bright but balanced colors.
art_direction.reference_policy: Use the user's reference only as a high-level description of the broad cartoon style. Never upload, attach, feed, trace, copy, recreate, or otherwise use the reference screenshot/image as an input asset for any agent or video-generation model. All four avatars below are original designs created from written descriptions.
art_direction.consistency: Each agent must use only its assigned character. Keep face, hairstyle, outfit, palette, proportions, and signature accessory consistent across that agent's videos. Characters must be independently drawn/animated; do not reuse the same base character with only a recolored hoodie.
art_direction.animation: Use simple 2D motions such as blinking, mouth movement, pointing, nodding, hand gestures, and small body movement.
